tests.scope: 512-phase exhaustive function comparison; same-cycle complete 1280x720 award_fx output differential against frozen original production source renamed only; shared real sprite ROM; five-clock bypass identity checked.
Real production UART TX/RX; local state/timer positioning only for deterministic reconnect/CRC collision.

Only timeout comparison implementation changes. Counter wraps at 32 bits, timer_reset exposes zero immediately and loads count=1 on the next edge. All packet/control logic outside this timer block is unchanged. Actual old/new timer code compared around each threshold, wrap and randomized clears in nine parameter configurations.

Only four scene-selection controls gain one register. All other top wiring and all RGB/DE/coordinate data paths remain byte-identical. Original conditions compared exhaustively with the actual registered production block, delayed one clock.
Actual production top and result FSM; hardware shells omit unrelated blocks. Same qualified event trace shifted one clock; raw busy feedback window settles one clock later.
Production photo_award_render plus photo_award_memory; players/video effect are interface stubs. Logical CDC/owner routing proof, not analog metastability simulation.
Production row decoder and arbiter versus pinned independent uncompressed donor, all 120 fields and 68 rows, both current/following cache banks, wrap, refresh/contention.

Two production renderers, independent caches versus a shared synchronous 512x32 cache. Six full 720p frames and old-new-old transitions, 50MHz memory/75MHz video, randomized grant waits, mixed four/sixteen-word response bursts, pause/touch, same-cycle final RGB/menu/errors/frame indexes and identical memory requests.

details.scope: Material data and same-size source detail comparison; CPU lighting oracle, not a board capture or optical sharpness measurement.
